data.name: Caravanners
data.detailed_description:
OVERHAUL COMEBACK REVAMP UPDATE WILL COMING

Current Version:
Caravanners is currently in its Early Access Alpha stage. (Unpolished)
The current version is still an early access and unpolished build and does not represent the quality I am aiming for the future of the game. What matters is not what we developers want, but what the players want and meeting their expectations. That is why Caravanners was released as an Early Access Alpha version, to receive player feedback and bring Caravanners to the level that players themselves imagine. In this way, Caravanners can gradually reach its final version based on feedback from the players.

Next Version: Overhaul Comeback Update (Revamp)
I am currently working on a major Overhaul Comeback Update, rebuilding and improving Caravanners across nearly every aspect of the experience.

From the menus and user interface to gameplay systems, environments, animations, optimization, graphical quality and overall presentation, many parts of the game are being extensively renewed.

The visual quality of the game is also receiving a major upgrade. Environments, lighting, assets and overall graphical fidelity are being reworked to deliver a significantly higher quality experience compared to the current Alpha version.

The Overhaul Comeback Update is being developed to bring Caravanners much closer to the quality and feature level we are targeting for Version 1.0.

Development of the Overhaul Comeback Update has been actively continuing since the beginning of 2026, and I look forward to sharing more with you as progress continues. To see images from the Overhaul Comeback Update and learn more about it, you can check the Overhaul devlogs in the Events and Announcements section.

The Overhaul Comeback Update (Revamp) is planned for release in late 2026 or early 2027.
A price increase for the game is planned alongside this update.

(These images are from the Overhaul Comeback Update.)


About the Game

Current Version: EARLY ACCESS ALPHA VERSION (Not Polished)

Next Version: Overhaul Comeback Update (Revamp) is currently in development.
The Overhaul Comeback Update has been in development since the beginning of 2026 based on player feedback, with menus, mechanics, gameplay, story, and graphics being revamped, and is intended to deliver significantly better visuals and an overall better gameplay experience compared to the current Alpha version.

Once completed, Caravanners will be much closer to Version 1.0 and will offer a significantly more polished experience. You can check the Events and Announcements section to see images from the Overhaul Comeback Update and get more information.

The Overhaul Comeback Update is planned for release in late 2026 or early 2027.
A Price Increase Is Planned After the Overhaul Comeback Update

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Caravanners is a chill exploration and life adventure centered around caravans and camping, set in a massive open world. Start from scratch with a small truck, buy an empty caravan, and design your dream camper. Explore nature by day, enjoy music by the campfire with friends at night. 🎵🔥

KEY FEATURES:

🔓 Massive open world

🏕️ Diverse regions and biomes

🌄 Dynamic weather system – Rain, fog, sun, snow

👥 Play solo or co-op with 1–4 players

🎯 Do various jobs and earn money

⚙️ Detailed caravan interior and exterior customization – Create your own style

🌔 Day-night cycle – Different vibes for day and night

🏕️ Caravan camping life – The world is your home

🚌 Travel in convoy with your friends using multiple caravans

🎯 A sustainable adventure awaits in a huge world without boredom

EXPLORE A MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

A big world ready to explore with swimmable lakes and seas, forests, islands, villages, towns, mountains, hidden places, and diverse regions!

YOUR CARAVAN IS YOUR HOME

🍲 Store your food in the fridge

🍳 Cook meals and feed yourself

🛋️ Sit on the couch, enjoy the view, play music

🪟 Open or close the curtains – set your mood

💡 Turn the lights on or off

🚽 Use the toilet in your caravan

⛺️ Set up your campsite with awnings around your caravan

DESIGN AND BUILD YOUR OWN CAMPSITE

Build the campsite of your dreams from scratch, alone or with friends!

Create your ideal camping spot with fully modular parts

🌄 Whether by a lake or deep in the woods anywhere can be your campsite!

🪑 Set up your table and chairs,

🔥 Light your campfire,

🎶 Play your music,

🥩 Grill your meat,

🧘 Chill with your friends!

True freedom awaits at your custom designed campsite.

How you live and what you do is entirely up to you! 🌲💫

RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

Hunger, thirst, sleep, toilet, fuel, food, money, reputation points – manage both personal and general resources.

CUSTOMIZATION – DESIGN YOUR DREAM CARAVAN

EXTERIOR CUSTOMIZATION – TUNING

Paint choices for body, wheels, and bumpers

Vehicle skins

Change bumpers, 

Change wheels,

Choose your accessories,

Create your own style

And more!

FURNITURE CUSTOMIZATION – DESIGN YOUR LIVING SPACE

You can also customize the interior walls, floor, and ceiling of your caravan.

Choose from wood, solid colors, or fabrics

Seat selection

Cabin selection

Decor selection

Curtain and fabric selection

Fridge, grill, sink, toilet... 

✅DON’T FORGET TO ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST!✅
